description: docs/36 R1b: live Deep Research set (20 questions, VI/EN, 6 domains). Scored by scripts/eval_research_live.py: job status, latency, server-side verification (citation coverage, unsupported sentences, numeric fidelity) plus independent checks — an expected domain among the citations and topic terms present in the report. `key_terms` are topic words a relevant report must mention, NOT answers: they never encode a fact to be checked. Needs an LLM with real throughput; the keyless pollinations tier (1 reply / 45 s / IP) cannot run it in reasonable time.
